entries.6ea0c473303d3076: The company's core competencies are "glass material development," "precision molding" and "thin film," and it holds patents in Japan and overseas relating to glass polarizers, highly durable silver mirrors, pressure-resistant glass spheres and others. entries.f7a7d21a11daf50f: Founded in 1947 in Koto-ku, Tokyo, the company is a specialty glass manufacturer headquartered in Kashiwa, Chiba Prefecture. Together with its 5 consolidated subsidiaries, it forms a group of 6 companies and is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Headcount as of March 31, 2026 was 232.
entries.ff31879900376fc5: The company has formulated the medium-term management plan "GROWTH28" (covering the fiscal years ending March 2027 to March 2029) and plans to accelerate the transformation of its business portfolio by investing in expanded production capacity in growth areas such as heat-dissipating substrates for AI data centers and glass polarizers. In addition, it aims to strengthen competitiveness in existing fields such as the projector and lighting markets by introducing fine fly-eye lenses and new light guide devices.
